abrams.tagline: Abrams solves cases with his fists.
abrams.summary: Abrams solves cases with his fists. The Tome won't let him quit.

apollo.tagline: Apollo commands the stage with lethal grace.
apollo.summary: Apollo commands the stage with lethal grace. His audience never leaves alive.

baba.tagline: Baba feeds the pigeons and sees everything.
baba.summary: Baba feeds the pigeons and sees everything. The Cursed Apple listens when she speaks.

bebop.tagline: Bebop was built to be a son, not a weapon.
bebop.summary: Bebop was built to be a son, not a weapon. Now he's both.

billy.tagline: Billy is angry and doesn't know why.
billy.summary: Billy is angry and doesn't know why. The goat head probably doesn't help.

calico.summary: Calico kills for profit now. The Baxter Society lost a hero.

celeste.summary: Celeste dazzles from the sideshow. Her horn is worth more than she knows.

deadman-danny.summary: Danny died and kept working. Fairfax Industries doesn't do safety.

drifter.tagline: The Drifter preys on the living.
drifter.summary: The Drifter preys on the living. He has no respect for vampiric tradition.

dynamo.summary: Dynamo warps team fights. Singularity changes everything.

graves.summary: Graves listens to the dead. They're better company than the living.

grey-talon.tagline: Grey Talon hunted monsters for forty years.
grey-talon.summary: Grey Talon hunted monsters for forty years. Now he hunts people.

haze.summary: Haze picks off unsuspecting targets. OSIC keeps her secrets.

holliday.tagline: Holliday trick-shoots her way to victory.
holliday.summary: Holliday trick-shoots her way to victory. The murders brought her here.

infernus.summary: Infernus burns everything. His flames are his identity.

ivy.summary: Ivy protects her lucky ally. The gargoyle just wants to help.

kelvin.tagline: Kelvin freezes enemies in their tracks.
kelvin.summary: Kelvin freezes enemies in their tracks. The arctic holds secrets.

lady-geist.tagline: Lady Geist trades health for power.
lady-geist.summary: Lady Geist trades health for power. Oathkeep gave her a second chance.

lash.summary: Lash is an asshole. He dives down and stomps his foes.

mcginnis.summary: McGinnis builds turrets and killzones. She's been building since age four.

mina.tagline: Mina lost her future to an assassin.
mina.summary: Mina lost her future to an assassin. She wept for what was stolen.

mirage.summary: Mirage times his shots perfectly. The Djinn are curious beings.

mo-krill.summary: Mo & Krill burrow underground. The Tunnel Rats move in the dark.

nurse-harrow.summary: Harrow combats supernatural possession. Some call her a saint.

paige.summary: Paige grew up loving stories. Her brother didn't.

paradox.summary: Paradox manipulates space and time. The thieves' guild never gets caught.

pocket.tagline: Pocket hides in a mystic suitcase.
pocket.summary: Pocket hides in a mystic suitcase. Arin Fairfax is alive and in hiding.

rat-king.tagline: The Rat King rules the Warrens.
rat-king.summary: The Rat King rules the Warrens. He wants to walk the surface.

rem.tagline: Rem is stranded in the city.
rem.summary: Rem is stranded in the city. The dream world lost him.

seven.summary: Seven electrocutes crowds. The government made rules for a reason.

shiv.summary: Shiv bleeds out his foes. The Baxter Society is wary of him.

silver.summary: Lilah Silver is a mess. She drinks, smokes, and hunts bounties.

sinclair.summary: Sinclair misdirects enemies. Henry was too young for real magic.

solomon.summary: Solomon listens and counsels. Chess is his language.

the-doorman.tagline: The Doorman is more than he seems.
the-doorman.summary: The Doorman is more than he seems. The Baroness Hotel hides secrets.

venator.summary: Venator observes and exterminates. The Vatican sent her here.

victor.tagline: Victor woke up on a mortuary table.
victor.summary: Victor woke up on a mortuary table. He searches for answers.

vindicta.summary: Vindicta snipes the unsuspecting. Salem gave her a second chance.

violet.tagline: Violet found her passion in art.
violet.summary: Violet found her passion in art. The city embraced her.

viscous.summary: Viscous rolls around deflecting bullets. The Adversary hunts the seas.

vyper.summary: Vyper slithers in and assassinates. She's escaped every prison.

warden.summary: Warden weakens his enemies. His lineage fights in the shadows.

wraith.summary: Wraith melts isolated targets. She's above the law.

yamato.summary: Yamato delivers charged attacks. She needs every shot to count.
